{{Quote|I'm back home after touring with my band, the Dewback Ramblers. You know us? -- Well, never mind.|Blerx Tango, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
'''Blerx Tango''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Music/Legends|musician]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was the leader of a band called the [[Dewback Ramblers]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Blerx worked in the [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] farm of [[Domo Jones]]' uncle. He and Domo fall in love with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] of the [[Mos Zabu/Legends|Mos Zabu]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] named [[JillJoo Jab]]. Around the same time, Blerx toured on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Orto/Legends|Orto]]. Some time later, Domo Jones decided to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by sabotaging an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] purchase of [[Nergon-14]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] from the criminal [[Ep Gart]]. He therefore enlisted the help of Blerx, JillJoo Jab and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[UR-1]]. The four successfully foiled the Imperial plot by causing a herd of [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] to stampede the location of the sale.<ref name="NH">{{Tales|7|Nerf Herder}}</ref>

[[File:Blerx-tango.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Blerx Tango in the Lucky Star cantina]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Blerx Tango and the Dewback Ramblers operated out of the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|Lucky Star]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]]. Tango was the leader of the band and played [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]].<ref name="SWG:BT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he learned that a fellow band member named [[Jakko Mixon]] got stranded in the desert. Jakko had fallen for an old trick, a scam where he believed he would get a cheap ride to [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. Fortunately, Blerx managed to employ the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], who sought out to find Jakko, and bring him back safely to Mos Entha. However, the troubles had not yet ended for Blerx's band members. His [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ommni box/Legends|ommni box]] player, [[Mellaw Doowon]], needed to be escorted back safely after making some bad jokes with Imperial authorities. Once again, the spacer was tasked to find Mellaw, and bring him back to Blerx. Unfortunately for the spacer, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] would not let Mellaw be escorted back. The stormtrooper opened fire, forcing the spacer to kill the trooper. Yet the ordeals were not yet over. Another band member, [[Baze Joz]], ended up biting an agent from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Committed, the spacer sought out Baze Joz, so that he too could be brought back to Jakko. When the spacer approached Baze, he was attacked by three Imperial [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]]. The three sergeants were ultimately dispatched by the spacer, allowing him to bring Baze home safely. In addition to the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that Blerx provided the spacer, he was also awarded a [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargon]] for his service.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blerx Tando first appeared in the comic ''[[Nerf Herder]]'', published in [[Star Wars Tales 7|''Star Wars Tales'' 7]], where he was only named Blerx.<ref name="NH" /> Blerx and other characters from the comic, JillJoo Jab and Domo Jones, were later used in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, players aligned with the Rebel Alliance could help Blerx rescue his three band members.<ref name="SWG:BT" />
